blurb: Bay to Bay Charters operates an 8 passenger 23 ft enclosed heated cabin vessel certified by Transport Canada. They offer private charters and scheduled water taxi services between Sidney BC and various Gulf Islands and Friday Harbor WA. Complimentary shuttle service is provided for Victoria Airport, BC Ferries Swartz Bay, and downtown Sidney.
